Our company

Industry and international trade

Based in Port Sudan, Maria Group brings together industrial and commercial activities. Its RHINO portfolio includes edible oil, iron products, animal feed, biscuits and bakery products, beverages, and tomato paste. Maria Multi Activities handles commercial imports.

RHINO INDUSTRIES

Our industrial divisions

Six industrial divisions. The feed factory is under construction and the biscuit factory is at the equipment installation stage; operating status is not confirmed for beverages and tomato paste.
